legal.translation_notice: This is an informative translation. The legally binding text is the Spanish version.
legal.aviso.p1: The website signaplan.com and the SignaPlan SaaS are operated by {name}{nif}{domicilio}. Contact email: {email}.
legal.aviso.p2: For any question about this notice, write to {email}.
legal.aviso.p3: This notice governs access to and use of the commercial website, account signup and customer workspaces under a subdomain or custom domain linked to SignaPlan (site planning, people, fleet and working-time record).
legal.aviso.p4: The user agrees to use the site and the service lawfully, not to enter false information and not to attempt to access other organisations’ workspaces. Access to each customer workspace is restricted to users authorised by that organisation.
legal.aviso.p5: The software, the SignaPlan brand, texts, designs and other service content are protected by applicable law. Unauthorised reproduction, distribution or exploitation is prohibited.
legal.aviso.p6: SignaPlan works to keep the service available and secure, without being able to guarantee uninterrupted availability. The customer is responsible for how their workspace is used, for their users’ credentials and for the accuracy of the data they enter (including worker data).
legal.aviso.p7: This notice is governed by Spanish law. For any dispute, the parties submit to the courts of the owner’s domicile, unless a mandatory rule says otherwise (in particular for consumers).
legal.privacidad.li1: As controller for the commercial website, account signup and the contractual relationship with the customer company (administrator contact data, billing where applicable).
legal.privacidad.li2: As processor for worker and collaborator data that each customer company enters in its isolated workspace (planning, leave, clock-ins, vehicles, etc.). See the
legal.privacidad.li3: Account data: company name, subdomain, administrator email and password.
legal.privacidad.li4: Worker data provided by the customer: identification (name, ID number when supplied), role, site assignments, leave, working-time records, clock-in PIN (stored irreversibly/hashed) and, if the customer enables it, geolocation tied to the clock-in.
legal.privacidad.li5: Technical data: IP address, access logs and essential session and security cookies.
legal.privacidad.li6: Providing the SaaS (performance of the contract / pre-contractual steps).
legal.privacidad.li7: Service security (legitimate interest: preventing abuse and improper access).
legal.privacidad.li8: Complying with legal obligations (e.g. tax or replies to authorities).
legal.privacidad.li9: Support communications related to the account.
legal.privacidad.p2: Geolocation at clock-in is only used if the customer enables it in their settings and under their own legal basis towards their workers.
legal.privacidad.p3: Account data are kept while the relationship is active and afterwards for the legal billing and civil-liability periods. Working-time records and related events are kept under applicable labour rules (indicatively up to four years for the working-time record) and the customer’s instructions, unless a longer legal duty applies.
legal.privacidad.p4: Hosting, database, email and, where applicable, payment providers may intervene under contract with equivalent duties. Data are not sold to third parties for commercial purposes. If the customer connects an ERP (e.g. Odoo), processing in that system remains the customer’s responsibility.
legal.privacidad.p5: We prefer infrastructure in the European Economic Area. If a provider ever processes data outside the EEA, GDPR safeguards will apply (standard clauses or other adequate measures).
legal.privacidad.p6: You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection, and withdraw consent where the basis is consent, by writing to {email}. You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).
legal.privacidad.p7: If your company entered your data in SignaPlan, in many cases you should first exercise your rights with that company (controller). SignaPlan will assist as processor.
legal.privacidad.p8: The service is aimed at companies. It is not intended for signup by people under 18.
legal.cookies.p1: Cookies (and similar technologies) are small files or data the browser stores so the site can work (session, security) or, where applicable, to measure use.
legal.cookies.li1: Essential / technical: user session cookie, CSRF token (protection against request forgery), minimal UI technical preferences and the record of your cookie choice (sp_cookie_consent). They are needed to provide the service and do not require extra consent.
legal.cookies.li2: Analytics: only if you allow it in the cookie banner and we have a Google Analytics identifier configured. In that case Google scripts (gtag) load to measure aggregate use of the commercial site. You can choose “Essential only” and they will not load.
legal.cookies.li3: Marketing: not active by default. If they are added later (e.g. advertising pixels), prior consent will be requested and this policy will be updated.
legal.cookies.p2: Essential cookies rest on the need to provide the requested service. Non-essential cookies (analytics/marketing) rest on your consent, which you can withdraw by deleting browser cookies or choosing again in the banner.
legal.cookies.p3: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If you block essential ones, you may not be able to sign in or complete signup. On commercial pages you can also change your preference with the cookie banner (the “Cookies” footer link or by deleting the sp_cookie_consent cookie).
legal.condiciones.p1: These terms govern use of the SignaPlan service, cloud software for companies (site planning, people, fleet and working-time record), operated by {name}.
legal.condiciones.p2a: By creating an account you accept these terms and the
legal.condiciones.p2b: You must provide accurate data and keep the administrator credentials safe. You are responsible for the activity of users you invite to your workspace.
legal.condiciones.p3: Signup may be offered without a card and with access to the features available on the platform at each time. SignaPlan may introduce paid plans or limits with reasonable prior notice; until billing is switched on, no payment method is required for the use described on the website.
legal.condiciones.p4: It is forbidden to use the service for unlawful activity, to infringe third-party rights, to attempt to access other customers’ workspaces, to abusively overload the infrastructure or to bypass security measures. SignaPlan may suspend accounts that break these rules, giving notice when reasonable.
legal.condiciones.p5a: The customer is the controller of their workforce data and must have an adequate legal basis (employment relationship, information to workers, etc.). SignaPlan acts as processor under the
legal.condiciones.p5b: The working-time record and other compliance features are support tools; the customer must ensure regulatory compliance in their organisation.
legal.condiciones.p6: The service may evolve (new features, fixes, maintenance). Reasonable prior notice will be given of substantial changes to these terms or of relevant planned downtime. SignaPlan does not guarantee uninterrupted availability.
legal.condiciones.p7: SignaPlan and the associated software are owned by {name} or its licensors. The customer receives a non-exclusive right of use, limited to their organisation, while the account is active.
legal.condiciones.p8: To the extent permitted by law, SignaPlan is not liable for indirect damages, lost profit or data loss arising from misuse, from the customer’s settings or from third-party integrations (e.g. an ERP). Nothing in these terms limits liability for wilful misconduct or for duties that the law does not allow to exclude.
legal.condiciones.p9: The relationship lasts while the account is active. The customer may request termination by writing to {email}. After termination, the data-processing addendum applies to export and deletion of data.
legal.encargado.p1: This document governs the processing of personal data between:
legal.encargado.li1: The SignaPlan customer company (controller of its workers’ and collaborators’ data), and
legal.encargado.p2: By creating an account and using the service, the customer accepts this processing framework. If a specific DPA is signed later, that document prevails where it is incompatible.
legal.encargado.p3: The processor will process, on behalf of the customer and for the life of the account, the data needed to provide SignaPlan: identification and operational employment data of employees and collaborators, site assignments, leave, clock-ins and working-time events (including geolocation if the customer enables it), vehicle data and audit logs associated with the service.
legal.encargado.p4: Processing is automated and limited to the purposes of the service (planning, time clock, fleet, working-time reports and workspace administration). The processor will only process the data under the customer’s documented instructions (including product settings) and applicable law, without using them for its own purposes unrelated to the service.
legal.encargado.li3: Ensure authorised people commit to confidentiality.
legal.encargado.li4: Adopt adequate technical and organisational measures (multi-tenant isolation, role-based access, encryption of integration secrets, integrity measures on working-time events when the module is active).
legal.encargado.li5: Not disclose the data to third parties except authorised sub-processors, a legal duty or the customer’s instruction.
legal.encargado.li6: Assist the customer, to the reasonable extent of the product, with data-subject rights and security-breach notices.
legal.encargado.li7: Make available to the customer the information needed to demonstrate compliance with this addendum.
legal.encargado.li8: Have a legal basis to process workforce data and inform data subjects under the GDPR and labour law.
legal.encargado.li9: Configure the product properly (roles, geolocation, modules) and not enter unnecessary data.
legal.encargado.li10: Handle their workers’ rights requests; SignaPlan will assist as processor.
legal.encargado.p5: Infrastructure, hosting, email or other necessary technical providers may intervene, under contract and with equivalent duties. SignaPlan will inform of relevant sub-processor changes when required. Contact: {email}.
legal.encargado.p6: If a security breach affects the customer’s data, the processor will notify the customer without undue delay so the customer can meet its notification duties.
legal.encargado.p7: When the service ends, the customer may export their data in the formats available in the product. SignaPlan will then delete or return the customer workspace information, except a legal duty to keep it or a block needed to exercise or defend claims.
